drums.description: Mid-tempo indie rock instrumental, A clean electric guitar plays a repetitive, palm-muted eighth-note arpeggio pattern in the center of the mix, A second electric guitar with light overdrive enters, playing sustained melodic lead lines with moderate reverb, The drum kit features a steady kick on every beat with a crisp snare on two and four, accompanied by consistent eighth-note closed hi-hats, A melodic electric bass follows the chord progression with a rounded, warm tone, The arrangement maintains a steady dynamic level throughout, 115 BPM, 4/4 time signature, Key of G Major Publish

bass.description: Indie rock with a prominent surf-rock influence, The track features a clean, reverb-drenched electric guitar playing a melodic lead line with frequent slides and vibrato, A second electric guitar provides rhythmic support with palm-muted downstrokes, The bass guitar follows a driving eighth-note pattern, locking with a steady drum kit featuring a crisp snare and consistent hi-hat hits, The tempo is approximately 120 BPM in the key of E major, The arrangement is centered around a recurring guitar hook that utilizes the lower strings for a twangy, retro aesthetic, Production is clean with minimal processing beyond spring reverb on the guitars Publish
